## Hypothesis

H1: Those who report a history of infidelity (categorical) will report lower relationship satisfaction/commitment (composite).

H2: Willingness to marry without love will be negatively correlated with age.

```{r load package}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrain)
```

## Load the processed data

```{r loadData}
#load processed data
h1Data <- read.csv("script/data/processed_data/practice_h1.csv")
h2Data <- read.csv("script/data/processed_data/practice_h2.csv")

#reorganize categorical variable
table(h1Data$infidelity)
h1Data$infidelity <- factor(h1Data$infidelity,
                           levels=c("No Infidelity","Infidelity"))
table(h1Data$infidelity)

```

## H1 - Violin Plot (with Box Plot)

```{r H1Violin}
#Violin Plot
#Wider sections show where responses are more concentrated within each group.
#The shape depends on smoothing; integer scores can create bumps.
#Violin width does not show group sample size. The box adds the median and IQR.
h1Viol <- ggplot(data=h1Data,
                aes(x=infidelity,
                    y=satisfaction_commitment,
                    fill=infidelity)) +
  geom_violin()+
  geom_boxplot(width=.12)+
  labs(x="History of Infidelity",
       y="Satisfaction and Commitment in Relationship",
       fill="History of Infidelity",
       title="Relationship Satisfaction and Commitment by History of Infidelity")+
  theme_minimal(base_size=8)

h1Viol

```


## H2 - Scatter Plots

```{r H2Scatter}

#Jittered scatter plot
h2Jitter <- ggplot(
  data=h2Data,
                    aes(x=Age,
                        y=Love_would_you_marry_1))+
    geom_jitter(width = .12,height=.04,alpha=.04,size = .6)+
    labs(x="Age",
       y="Willingness to marry without love",
       title="Willingness to Marry Without Love with Age")+
  theme_gray(base_size = 18)



#alpha is opacity
h2Jitter


```

## H2 - Smooth Line

```{r}
#Scatter Plot with line
h2Line <- h2Jitter + geom_smooth(method="lm")

h2Line

```

## Save figures

```{r saveFigures}
#Run after creating the plots. Save PNG files in the project's figures folder.
dir.create("figures",showWarnings=FALSE)
ggsave("figures/h1_violin.png",plot=h1Viol,width=10,height=6,dpi=300)
ggsave("figures/h2_scatter.png",plot=h2Line,width=10,height=6,dpi=300)
#To save another plot, change the filename and plot object (e.g., h1Viol or h1Rain).
```
